say.en: At a hydroelectric station like Sharavathi, falling water spins coils in strong magnetic fields. With every turn of a coil the emf rises, falls and reverses: alternating current. In this lesson: Explain how an AC generator works.
Use epsilon equals NBA omega sin omega t and epsilon 0 equals NBA omega.

body.en: A coil of N turns and area A rotates with angular speed ω in a uniform field B. The angle between B and the coil's normal is θ = ωt, so Φ = NBA cos ωt and $\varepsilon = -d\Phi/dt = NBA\omega\sin\omega t$. The peak emf is ε₀ = NBAω and the frequency is ν = ω/2π. The emf is maximum when the plane of the coil is parallel to B (flux zero, but changing fastest) and zero when the plane is perpendicular to B (flux maximum). Slip rings and carbon brushes take the current out of the *rotating coil*.
body.kn: B ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ω ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗುವ ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ε = NBAω sin ωt; ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ε₀ = NBAω. ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಗರಿಷ್ಠವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಶೂನ್ಯ.

title.en: On the board: the AC generator

narration.en: A coil of N turns and area A spins at angular speed ω in a field B; θ = ωt is the angle between its normal and B. The flux linkage NBA cos ωt keeps changing, so the emf is NBAω sin ωt, with peak value ε₀ = NBAω. The emf is a sine wave: largest when the coil's plane lies along B, and zero when the coil faces B. Example: 100 turns of area 0.1 m² turning at 0.5 revolution per second in 0.01 T give ε₀ = 100 × 0.01 × 0.1 × π ≈ 0.314 V. Slip rings and brushes carry this alternating emf out of the spinning coil.

homework.en: Sketch Φ and ε against time for one full rotation of a generator coil.

narration.en: Recap. ε = NBAω sin ωt; peak ε₀ = NBAω. Emf is largest when the flux is zero, and zero when the flux is largest. Slip rings and brushes carry the current out.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ε = NBAω sin ωt; ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ε₀ = NBAω. ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಗರಿಷ್ಠವಾದಾಗ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಸ್ಲಿಪ್ ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರಷ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. epsilon equals NBA omega sin omega t; peak epsilon 0 equals NBA omega.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. epsilon equals NBA omega sin omega t; ಗರಿಷ್ಠ epsilon 0 equals NBA omega.

say.en: Emf is largest when the flux is zero, and zero when the flux is largest.
say.kn: ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಅಭಿವಾಹ ಗರಿಷ್ಠವಾದಾಗ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

say.en: Slip rings and brushes carry the current out.
say.kn: ಸ್ಲಿಪ್ ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರಷ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ.
